svg.aria-label: pyrox-nn on the GeoStack role ladder: last_layer_laplace and the estimators' fit as algorithms; the Bayesian dense, random-feature, neural-field, conditioning, ensemble and head layers and the fitted posteriors and fields as models; the estimators as strategies; the feature functions, the table helpers and the fitted objects' methods as primitives; no structure of its own. Beside the ladder, geonnax's re-exported cores and the pyrox verbs that make every site.
